subject: Co-sell demo — staggered facilitator windows & fallback cadence
messages:
From: Alice Huang <alice@cloudwave.io>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: CloudWave SI <si-team@cloudwave.io>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 08:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Co-sell demo: multiple windows proposal + facilitator plan

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for the intro call yesterday — CloudWave is excited to move the joint demo into a hands-on session with the SI and an AWS presence. To avoid forcing a single long block across timezones, we wanted to propose staggered facilitator windows so each party can cover their segment and we can keep the total attendee time under 90 minutes.

Proposed plan (all times PT):
- 09:00–09:20 PT — Intro + business value (CloudWave lead)
- 09:20–09:50 PT — Redwood product walkthrough + Q&A (Sofia)
- 09:50–10:10 PT — SI integration & deployment steps (SI)
- 10:10–10:20 PT — AWS advice on infra & marketplace (AWS PM)

We can also run a fallback cadence: if the AWS PM can't make the 10:10 slot, AWS provides a recorded 10-minute checklist and we extend QA to 20 minutes and follow up with a 30-minute technical deep-dive the following week.

Do these windows work for you and your team? We have calendar slots on Tues/Wed next week that match; I attached a small availability ICS and a runbook draft for reference.

Next steps: confirm which day, and whether Redwood wants the AWS PM looped live or the recorded fallback.

Thanks —
Alice Huang
Partnerships, CloudWave
attachments: calendar-availability.ics (ics), demo-runbook-v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Huang <alice@cloudwave.io>, CloudWave SI <si-team@cloudwave.io>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Dec 2026 09:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Co-sell demo: multiple windows proposal + facilitator plan

Alice — thanks, this staggered approach looks sensible and reduces cognitive load for each team. Quick notes from Redwood: 

- We can cover the 09:20–09:50 PT slot. Sofia (me) will run the demo and leave 10 minutes for product Q&A.
- Sergio will be on the call for quick Cost/Performance commentary and to capture any ops flags.
- Marissa will coordinate logistics + the HubSpot deal doc and share meeting notes.

We prefer AWS PM live if possible; recorded fallback is ok but we'd like to avoid technical debt in follow-ups. If AWS availability is uncertain, please propose two candidate days and we can lock the one that has the PM live.

Proposed days that work for Redwood (PT):
- Tue Dec 22: 09:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Dec 23: 09:00–10:30 PT

I'll attach the Redwood runbook link in thread after a quick pass — Marissa, can you upload the short playbook to our shared doc and confirm the final calendar invite?

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
S: +1 (415) 555-0123

Hi all — appreciate the heads-up. I can join live on Tue Dec 22 but only until 10:05 PT due to back-to-back customer briefings. If we move the AWS segment earlier by 5 minutes (10:05 -> 10:00 PT) I can cover the marketplace checklist live in 8–10 minutes. Otherwise I will send the recorded checklist and a short run-deck.

Action items:
- Alice: please tentatively hold Tue Dec 22 09:00–10:30 PT as primary, Wed Dec 23 as backup.
- Sofia: be prepared to compress Q&A by 5 minutes if AWS joins live. Sergio — please capture any infra follow-ups we need to spin up post-call.

I'll upload the AWS checklist here: https://s3.amazonaws.com/aws-partner-assets/cloudwave-checklist.pdf (perm link)

Thanks,
Jordan Blake (on behalf of AWS Partner Team)
Partner Program Manager — Strategic Accounts

Perfect — thanks Jordan & Alice. Let's lock Tue Dec 22 09:00–10:30 PT and run the AWS segment at 10:00 PT to match Jordan's availability. Marissa has sent the invite (see calendar attachment) and I've pasted runbook notes below.

Runbook highlights (short):
- Pre-call: CloudWave to share 2 slides of customer context; Redwood to validate model selection/quantization profile; SI to confirm deployment pattern (k8s/CloudFormation).
- Live: 09:00–09:20 CloudWave intro; 09:20–09:50 Redwood demo; 09:50–10:00 SI integration; 10:00–10:10 AWS checklist + live Qs; 10:10–10:30 Extended QA or follow-ups.
- Post-call: Sergio to create infra ticket if any infra blockers; Marissa to attach meeting notes to HubSpot (deal D-7341) and create follow-up tasks.

Attachments: demo-runbook-v2.pdf, calendar-availability.ics

See you all on Tue.

—
Sofia Ivanova
